Title: SL-18 Successful checkout calculates totals and completes the purchase
Suite Description: Adding and removing items, the cart badge, and cart contents across navigation.
Description:
Successful checkout calculates totals and completes the purchase.

Legacy ID: SL-18
Platforms: Android, iOS
Automated by: CartTest.testSuccessfulCheckoutCalculatesTotalsAndCompletesPurchase
Test data: standard_user / secret_sauce; Test / User / 12345
Pre-conditions: Swag Labs app is installed and launched on the device
Step Action:
1. Log in with a valid user
2. Add the first two products and record their names and displayed prices
3. Open the cart and tap CHECKOUT
4. Enter valid first name last name and postal code then tap CONTINUE
5. Compare the overview line items with the products recorded from the UI
6. Calculate the expected subtotal by summing the recorded UI prices
7. Calculate tax at 8 percent from the expected subtotal and add it to the subtotal
8. Tap FINISH
9. Tap BACK HOME
Expected Result:
1. Products page opens and the PRODUCTS header is displayed
2. The cart badge displays 2 and the product values are captured from the UI
3. The checkout information page opens
4. The checkout overview page opens
5. The same product names and displayed prices appear in the overview
6. The displayed item subtotal equals the calculated subtotal
7. The displayed tax and total equal the values calculated from the UI prices
8. The checkout complete page opens and BACK HOME is displayed
9. The Products page opens and the cart badge is cleared

Title: SL-22 Cancelling checkout preserves the cart
Suite Description: Adding and removing items, the cart badge, and cart contents across navigation.
Description:
Cancelling checkout preserves the cart.

Legacy ID: SL-22
Platforms: Android, iOS
Automated by: CartTest.testCheckoutCancelPreservesCart
Test data: standard_user / secret_sauce; Test / User / 12345
Pre-conditions: Swag Labs app is installed and launched on the device
Step Action:
1. Log in with a valid user and add the first product while recording its UI values
2. Open the cart and tap CHECKOUT
3. Tap CANCEL on checkout information
4. Reopen the cart and compare its item with the recorded UI values
5. Return to checkout and submit valid customer information
6. Tap CANCEL on checkout overview
7. Reopen the cart and compare its item with the recorded UI values
Expected Result:
1. The Products page opens and the cart badge displays 1
2. The checkout information page opens
3. The Products page opens and the cart badge still displays 1
4. The cart still contains the same product name and displayed price
5. The checkout overview page opens
6. The Products page opens and the cart badge still displays 1
7. The cart still contains the same product name and displayed price
